## 0. DESIGN BRIEF & THEME DIRECTION

**Mood:** A digital atelier. Solid wood, full-grain leather, aged gold, and warm beige canvas. Every element must feel handcrafted, exclusive, and robust: generous whitespace, slow confident motion (0.6s ease-in-out), classic serif display type over clean sans-serif body.

**Color Palette → CSS Variable Mapping (Light "Atelier" mode — the default and primary experience):**
- `--primary: #4A2C2A` (Dark Brown — brand, primary buttons, headings)
- `--secondary: #B8860B` (Aged Gold — signature 2px borders, icons, accents). Gold is decorative at small sizes; define `--gold-text: #8B6508` for small gold text to meet WCAG AA.
- `--bg-primary: #F5F5DC` (Beige — page canvas, never pure white)
- `--bg-secondary: #fefefe` (near-white panels/cards)
- `--text-primary: #4A2C2A`; `--text-secondary: #36454F` (Lead Gray)
- `--text-success: #006400` (Bottle Green); `--text-error: #8B0000` (Deep Red — the palette contains no red; this shade harmonizes with dark brown)
- `--border-default: rgba(74, 44, 42, 0.25)`; `--border-success: #006400`; `--border-error: #8B0000`
- Supporting tokens: `--wood: #4A2C2A`, `--leather: #3B2422`, `--green: #006400`, `--navy: #000080`, `--lead: #36454F`. Pure black `#000000` is reserved for the footer band and text accents only.

**Exception clause (white):** The source CSS spec lists `background: #FFFFFF`. Per mandatory background rules, substitute `#fefefe` wherever a white/near-white surface is required. `#ffffff` must not appear anywhere.

**Dark Mode tokens ("Workshop Night" — mandatory, see 1.3):** `--bg-primary: #1C110E`; `--bg-secondary: #2A1A15`; `--text-primary: #F5F5DC`; `--text-secondary: #C9B8A6`; gold brightens to `#D4A017` (both `--secondary` and `--gold-text`); borders become `rgba(245, 245, 220, 0.2)`; primary buttons invert to aged-gold backgrounds with `#1C110E` text.

**Typography (Google Fonts only):** Display/headings: **Lora** (serif) — per source spec `font-family: "Lora", serif`. Body/UI: **Inter** (sans-serif). Load both via Google Fonts `<link>` tags with `preconnect`. Bind `--font-display: 'Lora', serif` and `--font-base: 'Inter', sans-serif`.

**Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Rounded), loaded via Google Fonts. **Forbidden:** inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji used as icons.

**Signature Visual Effects (CSS-only — no external texture image files):**
- `.solid-wood-texture` — wood grain built from layered `repeating-linear-gradient` streaks over the dark brown base. Use on the Final CTA band and hero texture strip.
- `.leather-detail` — leather grain via layered `radial-gradient` stippling in dark brown. Use on testimonial card accent bands, badges, and the footer band.
- `.product-zoom-hover` — product image frames: `overflow: hidden`; on hover/focus-within the image scales to `scale(1.08)` with a subtle brightness lift over 0.6s ease-in-out.
- **Layer-reveal section transitions** — content enters the viewport with staggered fade/rise (specification in Section 3).
- **Warm photographic treatment** — all product imagery receives `filter: sepia(0.15) saturate(0.95) contrast(1.02)` for a unified crafted mood.
- **Signature border style:** `2px solid var(--secondary)` with `border-radius: 5px` (`--radius-sm`), applied to buttons, image frames, and emphasized cards.

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. **Forbidden:** `style="..."` attributes, `<style>` blocks in HTML, and presentational HTML attributes.
- Target everything via class/ID selectors. HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — reskinning the site must require editing `style.css` only.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- All tokens defined in `:root`; theme overrides in `.dark` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`.
- Required set: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, plus theme extras (`--gold-text`, `--wood`, `--leather`), `--font-display`, `--font-base`, `--radius-sm: 5px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 18px`, warm-tinted `--shadow-sm` / `--shadow-md` (e.g., `0 2px 8px rgba(74,44,42,0.12)`), `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 0.25s ease-in-out`, `--transition-normal: 0.6s ease-in-out`, `--ease-standard: ease-in-out`, `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`.
- **Contrast pairing enforced in every theme:** light background ↔ dark text; dark background ↔ light text.
- **Transition note:** the source spec demands `transition: all 0.6s ease-in-out`. Adopt 0.6s ease-in-out as the signature pacing via `--transition-normal`, but prefer property-specific transitions (`transform`, `opacity`, `box-shadow`, `border-color`, `filter`) for performance.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Define dark tokens under both a `.dark` class selector and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (the media query applies only when no stored preference exists).
- **Theme toggle:** a visible button in the header using Material Symbols `light_mode` / `dark_mode`, with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). Persist the choice in `localStorage` (key: `robusto-theme`); fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Apply the stored theme at the top of `script.js` (deferred) — light is the default, so no flash occurs for first-time visitors. Background/text variables must switch with zero HTML restructuring.
- **Exception clause:** the source specification requested light-only ("✗ No" dark mode). Dark mode remains mandatory per architecture; the light "Atelier" mode is the default and primary experience, with "Workshop Night" delivered as a fully tokenized, equally polished counterpart.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified (e.g., `stretch` for equal-height card rows — permitted with a CSS comment).
- Mobile-first: multi-column rows convert to `flex-direction: column` below 768px; card rows use `flex-wrap: wrap` with `flex: 1 1 320px` children. No horizontal scrolling at any viewport. Fluid type via `clamp()`.

**1.5 Framework Default**
- Use clean custom CSS organized in Tailwind-style `@layer` blocks (`tokens → base → layouts → components → utilities`) in `style.css`. All utilities must map back to CSS variables or reusable component classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, plus the three spec-mandated utility classes `.solid-wood-texture`, `.leather-detail`, `.product-zoom-hover`.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Google Fonts `<link>` for Lora + Inter; Google Fonts link for Material Symbols Rounded. No local fonts, no inline SVGs, no icon files.
- Type scale: hero display `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)` in Lora; section headings `clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem)` in Lora; body 1rem–1.0625rem Inter at `line-height: 1.65`.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--danger`)**
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; `border-radius: var(--radius-sm)`; Inter 600.
- **Primary:** dark brown background, beige text, 2px aged-gold border. **Secondary:** transparent background, brown text, 2px gold border (fills beige on hover). **Danger:** deep red background/border, visually distinct in both themes.
- **Hover:** brightness lift + `--shadow-md`, `cursor: pointer`. **Focus-visible:** distinct 3px gold outline with 2px offset. **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks (`pointer-events: none`, `aria-busy="true"`), renders an animated Material Symbol `progress_activity` (CSS rotation) or CSS border spinner without changing button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback colors driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` with icon feedback.

**2.2 Card Component (`.card`)**
- **Default:** flex column layout, `--bg-secondary` background, 1px `--border-default` that emphasizes to 2px gold on hover, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-md` + gold border, over 0.6s ease-in-out. **Focus-within:** gold border when any child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (skeleton):** `.skeleton` shimmer keyframe styles defined in CSS to prevent layout jumps. **Empty state:** structured fallback with a Material Symbol and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements (`.input-group`)**
- **Structure:** flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input field, and a dedicated error feedback container (`aria-live="polite"`).
- **States via CSS classes:** Empty, Focused (gold outline ring), Filled, Valid (green border + `check` icon), Invalid (red border, error icon, red message in the error container), Disabled, Read-only.

**2.4 Modal / Popup (if any dialog is used, e.g., a consultation confirmation)**
- **States:** Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated via CSS transitions. **UX:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`), backdrop, Material Symbol `close` button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` and overlay click, `z-index: var(--z-modal)`.

**2.5 FAQ Accordion (`.faq-item`)**
- Native `<button>` headers with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; panels with `role="region"`; Material Symbol `expand_more` chevron rotating 180°; smooth height animation via the CSS `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` technique; fully keyboard operable with gold focus rings.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` sizing, no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint.
- **Smooth animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal)`; **respect `prefers-reduced-motion`** — disable zoom scaling and reveal transforms, reduce transitions to opacity-only, render all content instantly.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both modes; never rely on color alone to communicate state; semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`, logical `h1`–`h3` hierarchy); correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; a "Skip to main content" link; `aria-live` regions for form feedback and any toast/loading announcements.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Product zoom micro-interaction:** `.product-zoom-hover` applies `scale(1.08)` + `brightness(1.05)` inside `overflow: hidden` gold-framed containers; triggered by both hover and `:focus-within` for keyboard users.
- **Layer-reveal section transitions:** an IntersectionObserver adds `.is-revealed`; initial state `opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px)`; transition 0.6s ease-in-out; stagger children by 80–120ms. **No-JS fallback:** content is fully visible when JavaScript does not run.
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.
